# SFA with embedded EasyTier core

Unofficial build of [SFA](https://github.com/reF1nd/sing-box-for-android) against
a sing-box core in which the EasyTier overlay network runs in-process as
WebAssembly (wazero) behind an `easytier` outbound. One Android `VpnService`
carries both proxy and overlay traffic. Not affiliated with sing-box, SFA,
reF1nd or EasyTier — see [NOTICE](../blob/main/NOTICE).

## Asset

`SFA-<version>-arm64-v8a-signed.apk` — release build, minified, signed with the
project key, `arm64-v8a` only.

Install over a previous build from this project is supported (same signing
certificate), so an existing overlay session does not have to be torn down.

## Verify before installing

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
apksigner verify --print-certs SFA-*-signed.apk
```

The certificate SHA-256 must equal the fingerprint printed below; anything else
means the asset was replaced in transit.

## Source of this build

The tagged commit in this repository is the complete corresponding source
(`sing-box/` core, `sfa/` client) together with the exact build recipe
(`.github/workflows/release.yml`). Builds have been observed to be byte-for-byte
reproducible across independent runners at the same commit.

## Provenance and license

A SLSA build-provenance attestation is attached to this release (generated by
`slsa-github-generator`, recorded in the public Rekor transparency log); see the
**Attestations** section of this release. Both source trees are GPL-3.0-or-later
with an additional non-association condition, unchanged — see
[`LICENSE`](../blob/main/LICENSE) and [`NOTICE`](../blob/main/NOTICE).

## Known limitations in this build

- `lazy` start-on-demand is unavailable on Android: the underlay SocketFactory
  path it requires is not implemented, and enabling it self-deadlocks the tunnel.
  It defaults to off.
- The embedded core is a socket-level hop; it does not create a TUN interface, so
  raw ICMP (`ping`) through the overlay is not carried by this outbound.
- `arm64-v8a` only.
